name: Anastasya
text: Eric has a beautiful dome up in the Catskills, with so much to do and enjoy. The fall foliage was incredible, there is something really special about the location. In the surrounding area you can go, horseback riding, goat herding, hiking, etc. If you’re looking for a unique experience definitely try out the dome. Everything you could ever need is provided at the property. The plunge pool was so rewarding this time of year when it’s chilly. Gorgeous views all around and felt right at home. This is our second stay, and we would definitely stay here again.

name: Susan
text: We had such a great time staying at the dome! The place was clean, cozy, and had everything we needed. The beds were super comfortable, and we loved how peaceful it was surrounded by all the beautiful fall foliage. It was a perfect spot to relax and enjoy some time away. Eric was an amazing host, super responsive whenever we had a question. We really enjoyed our stay would definitely come back!

name: Jacqueline
text: The dome was such a great space for our girls trip. The beds were very comfortable. Everything was very clean and welcoming. The kitchen was nicely stocked. The extras that were provided such as robes and games were really a nice touch! The outdoor space with the heated plunge pool is amazing! Eric was very responsive and friendly anytime I reached out to him. We look forward to visiting again!

name: Wilfred
text: Our stay was amazing! Loved every minute of it. Everything looked exactly like the pictures, even better in person. Loved the secluded open space, especially the hot tub with lovely Mountain View’s. Also saw some foliage and so many stars on a clear night with so many wild flowers everywhere surrounding the dome. Definitely have to come back here again! Tidbit: had to work remotely on one of the days, no issues with the internet. Went very smoothly. Hosts were also very responsive if you have any questions.

name: Victor Anthony
text: Great getaway with the family for a long and peaceful weekend. The dome was spotless and luxurious, yet one with nature. Eric was a great host with amazing communication.

name: Alexander
text: Thank you for allowing us to share a rest space. Everything was very nice! It was amazing, thank you very much!

name: James Francis
text: We loved our stay at the dome. Everything worked perfectly, super clean and well kept along with gorgeous scenery. The dome itself was so relaxing and cozy. Lots of hiking to do around the area we recommend Mine Kill State park. If you’re looking for a fun place to stay you should definitely try it out. Eric was a wonderful host and we would love to come back again.

name: Meaghan
text: My husband and I booked a trip at the dome to celebrate our anniversary. We absolutely loved it! It was exactly what we were looking for..Peaceful, relaxing and just us. There were so many thoughtful little touches throughout the place that made it feel really special. Everything was beautifully decorated, cozy, and even nicer in person than it looked in the pictures. The views from the dome were beautiful, and the surrounding area was just as amazing. We loved driving around and taking in the scenery and exploring the area. It was so peaceful and such a nice escape. You can tell a lot of thought and care went into making the Dome a great place to stay. Eric was a great host and very responsive. We had such a wonderful time and would definitely come back! I could only imagine how amazing it would be in the fall when the leaves are changing

name: Hirali
text: We absolutely loved it! The Dome was amazing and the views were phenomenal. The area was so peaceful. The property was great, we enjoyed as many of the amenities as we could. Eric was really responsive and proactive. He responded promptly and was really accommodating.

name: Terrence
text: This place was pretty incredible. When my “soon to be” college student daughter asked me to take her and a couple of friends to the dome for a weekend before school starts, I figured it was something cool to experience. But how comfortable could it be? I’m an avid camper and assumed the place would be nicer than a tent, but less comfy than a house. I am happy that I was wrong. This place was perfect. Clean, very nicely designed and furnished, and had every amenity I could ask for. It is as described, but pictures just don’t do it justice, as this place was visually, a showstopper. The host was attentive, informative, and incredibly welcoming. The property itself was peaceful and beautiful, no matter what direction you chose to look at. I would recommend a stay here to anyone.

name: Shenuque
text: Really gorgeous spot! Much bigger inside than it looks! Really comfortable for 5 adults! Wish we had stayed one extra day!

name: Ernesto
text: Amazing! Simply amazing. So relaxing and the Dome looks better in person. Eric and his team were amazing as they went above and beyond as host as they fulfilled a personal request to celebrate our 34th wedding anniversary. It was an amzing stay. The stars. OmG. The stars at night were gorgeous amd just made our stay evn more romantic in addition to the smokeless firepit. Thank you Eric. Hope to pass by again soon.

name: Lydia
text: Beautiful location and views. Eric was friendly and helpful. We had a wonderful and relaxing time!

name: Mike
text: Unique stay and very clean

name: Cody
text: Everything was great. Loved how private and secluded we felt.

name: Laval
text: What a beautiful escape with my husband and our dog Nitro! The space was thoughtfully designed and incredibly comfortable. We absolutely loved the cedar pool! The temperature was perfect, even on an 85 degree day. We spent our days grilling, swimming, and enjoying the peaceful views while our dog had plenty of space to explore. The wild flowers and butterflies were divine! Our evenings inside were just as wonderful. The bed was incredibly comfortable, the kitchen was spacious enough for the two of us to cook together, and the bathroom had fantastic water pressure. Eric was a gracious, responsive (even before our stay), and welcoming host throughout our stay. We also enjoyed exploring the surrounding towns, where we picked up fresh eggs, juicy watermelon, and antique books. Everyone we met was genuinely kind and welcoming. This was the perfect getaway to unplug from city life and spend a few relaxing days with our Frenchie. Thank you for such a wonderful stay. We would happily return

name: Thomas
text: This is a fantastic property. Beautiful location and amenities. Host was great. Highly recommended

name: Holden
text: The dome was awesome!!! My wife and I had a great time and it was so cozy and unique. Perfectly comfortable and livable. Beautiful scenery. Good hiking within an hour drive.

name: Liliana
text: Very cute, very unique place to stay. Surprisingly spacious once you’re inside . Perfect place for a girls weekend or couples getaway. We would def recommend and stay here again.

name: Sarah
text: I had an absolutely enchanting stay at the unique dome in the Catskills with my fiancé Matthew and our daughter Zoey. The interior decor was nothing short of stunning, creating an ambiance that felt both cozy and luxurious. The dome's architecture itself was a marvel, providing a one-of-a-kind experience that exceeded our expectations. Not only did it come equipped with all the necessities, but also delightful surprises that added an extra touch of comfort. The icing on the cake was the patio adorned with charming string lights and a relaxing hot tub. It was truly magical to soak in the warm waters under the starlit sky, surrounded by the majestic Mountain Views. The feeling of seclusion, tucked away from the hustle and bustle, was truly rejuvenating. It's hard to believe that despite this serene isolation, fantastic restaurants and stores were just a short 15-20 minutes away, striking the perfect balance between solitude and convenience.

name: Haley
text: Everything about our stay was easy, from checking in to relaxing on the grounds. Cody’s recommendations for the area were super helpful, as we had never been to the area prior. While the hot tub didn’t work for the time we stayed (there was a storm the night before we arrived which may have contributed), Cody was very responsive in trying to help us get it sorted, and sent someone to check it out the morning after we arrived. Although it didn’t end up working, Cody gave us a refund which let us know that he valued our experience staying at his listing. It is clear that they take great pride in their property and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

name: Eli
text: We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful and secluded dome. The property is incredibly private, surrounded by peaceful nature and stunning grounds that made it feel like a true retreat. Everything was clean and well-maintained, with thoughtful touches throughout the house that made us feel right at home. The pool was a definite highlight—nice and warm, perfect for relaxing during the day or unwinding in the evening. It added so much to the peaceful atmosphere of the property. One note for future guests: only one of the bedrooms has air-conditioning. That said, it was never a problem for us—while the afternoons can get warm, the evenings and nights were pleasantly cool and comfortable. We slept great! Overall, it’s a lovely place to unwind and enjoy the quiet. Highly recommend for anyone looking to relax in a serene setting.
host_response: Response from Eric August 2025 Thanks Eli! Yes, we have 3 total AC units in the Dome that cool all areas for a comfortable sleeping experience :)

name: Genevieve
text: Beautiful and unique stay! The dome was perfect for a weekend getaway with my husband. We both loved the outdoor space, including the huge hot tub and fire pit. We lucked out with beautiful spring weather and spent a good deal of time soaking up the scenery and relaxing outside. The dome itself was surprisingly spacious, clean, and comfortable. The king size bed was a definite bonus. The kitchen and bathroom were lovely and well laid out, but on the smaller side. We found them perfect for our needs, however these spaces could be more challenging if you were planning to cook all your meals or you had a larger group. Overall, I would say this stay was truly magical and we would definitely return.

name: Roger
text: Just enjoyed three enchanting nights at the Catskills dome—beyond expectations! This unique accommodation exceeded all expectations, providing a perfect blend of comfort and style. From entry, the cleanliness and tasteful design captivated me. The hosts' attention to detail created a welcoming and cozy atmosphere. Amenities stole the show. The hot tub offered a dreamy soak with mountain views. A tv in each room, a stocked kitchen, and an indoor fireplace in the living room—adding luxury. Games and books ensured constant entertainment. The host's responsiveness was exceptional, making the experience seamless. Contactless check-in added convenience. The location, ideal for a mountain retreat, provided a serene environment with stunning mountain views—a perfect escape from daily hustle. In summary, my stay at the Catskills dome was magical. Highly recommend this Airbnb for a memorable and comfortable getaway. Thanks to the hosts for creating such a special space!

name: Olivia
text: The interior of Cody’s place is stunning. Every detail is meticulously organized, and the cleanliness is impeccable. We found everything we needed for a comfortable stay, from kitchen essentials to cozy bedding. The highlight of our stay was the view from the outdoor pool. It is astonishing, offering a serene and picturesque backdrop that is perfect for relaxation. We spent most of our time enjoying this beautiful setting. Given that the property is situated in the middle of the woods, we did encounter a few insects inside the dome, which is to be expected in such a natural environment. There was also a small garter snake that made its way inside. However, Cody handled the situation promptly and professionally, ensuring the snake was safely removed. Overall, I was very impressed with Cody’s Airbnb. The combination of a stunning interior breathtaking views and excellent host responsiveness made our stay memorable. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking to escape into nature.

name: Weylin
text: I had a wonderful stay at this peaceful, secluded spot in upstate New York. The property was exactly what I was hoping for — quiet, cozy, and surrounded by nature. It felt like the perfect escape from the city, with plenty of space to unwind and recharge. The home was clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully prepared, and the host made everything easy from check‑in to checkout. I’d happily return for another relaxing getaway.

name: Natasha
text: We had an amazing time! The planning went smoothly. Cody gave us great suggestions of activities and restaurants. The ride there was gorgeous. Very easy to get to. Once we pulled up the scenery took my breath away! The dome is so neat and he definitely paid attention to detail when designing the place. The decor was super cute. The place was clean and had any and every amenity you could need! Cody was very responsive when we needed anything. The dome was super cozy and private. Very romantic and peaceful. The property is out of this world. The plunge pool was amazing. We stayed in it for hours while admiring the mountains surrounding us. Lots of fun activities to do near by such as hiking to waterfalls, horseback riding or just enjoying the quaint little town. Me & my husband will 100% be back. Im sure it’s amazing come fall & winter. This is going to be our new vacay spot. You will not be disappointed with this air b&b!!!

name: Tim
text: We had such a nice stay at Cody’s. The bubble was the perfect escape from the city for the weekend. Everything was just as described. The fire pit and hot tub were great ways to enjoy the outdoor area. We loved the large sofa right against the big window overlooking the mountains. Cody was very thorough in his instructions and communication. We would absolutely book this again.

name: Brooke
text: Just had the most wonderful weekend in the mountain dome! The location was absolutely gorgeous and felt very private and serene. This was a great location to enjoy nature and hiking in the area. The dome was so clean and well stocked- it was the perfect combination of being clean like a hotel but with a private location tucked away on the mountain. The kitchen was well-stocked and it was easy to cook a nice dinner. The dome was super clean and had awesome decor. Fireplace was easy to use and super cozy. The plunge pool was warm and relaxing after hiking all day. Cody was very responsive and a great host. Such a wonderful and fun yet peaceful weekend, I would go back in a heartbeat.

name: Shelly
text: We had a fabulous stay. My kids enjoyed the games and exploring the grounds. There was plenty of space inside for the 3 of us and the layout encouraged bonding family time. The views morning, noon, and night were beautiful and ever changing. It was a short drive to town to get supplies. We did not get cell service in the area, but the Wi-Fi was always working and strong. Just be sure to start your navigation before you leave! The dome was well stocked for cooking, but we also kept our at home meals simple. Coffee pot is a traditional ground coffee drip pot in case you are arriving late and need your coffee first thing in the morning like me :) Would definitely stay again.

name: Kimberly
text: Staying at the dome was such a great experience! It was super cozy and had all the essentials for a perfect weekend getaway. We especially appreciated the thoughtful guidebook Cody made, it had some amazing recommendations that really enhanced our trip. The hot tub was incredible and made for the perfect way to relax at the end of the day. Can’t wait to rebook again!

name: Jung
text: We cannot praise this place enough. Definitely top places we stayed so far on airbnb that far exceeded our expectations. Photos and descriptions are not enough to fully describe this place as it just blows your mind. This Dome experience is definitely the top notch luxurious glamping experience for sure. We specifically enjoyed the amenities area that was specially designed for privacy and relaxation. BBQ Grill, too quality fire-pit (smokeless), the world class hot tub with tanning chairs, games, etc. All in one place! The most amazing thing was that all this was in the middle of the mountain top with total privacy. Best thing was that our kids had so much fun in the tub during the night time with glow sticks. Its a must experience! Also want to mention that throughout the place, there are so many things/details that Cody prepared to ensure we had everything in need. Such as paper towels, disposable cups, lamps, games and etc. Such a beautiful place. Thank you Cody!

name: Daniela
text: Our stay at the domo was absolutely perfect! Cody was incredibly attentive, he responded quickly and answered every one of my questions with patience and care. He even sent us a super helpful guidebook with recommendations for restaurants, things to do in town, and local activities, which made our trip even better. The domo itself was exactly what my family and I needed: peaceful, quiet, and beautifully set up. It had all the tools and essentials we needed for a comfortable stay. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Thank you, Cody, for making our stay so easy and enjoyable!

name: Rose
text: We had a wonderful stay at the dome! I traveled with my husband and our sons, and we all loved the experience. The drive up was stunning, and spending two nights on top of the mountains was such a treat. The decor and cozy vibe were just what we were looking for. The boys especially enjoyed the heated pool and the fire pit. It was so nice making smores together in the evenings. Overall, a unique and beautiful getaway that we truly enjoyed!

name: Francisco
text: The Catskills Mountain Dome is amazing and such a unique experience! This place is unreal!!! I surprised my wife with a birthday road trip and the entire property simply took our breath away! Cody is an amazing host and was very responsive and accommodating. We felt very taken of. My two young daughters loved every second of staying here, they didn’t want to leave! All the little touches that Cody went the extra mile. The lanterns to walk down to the patio, board games for the family, vases with beautiful flowers. We ended up making a fire-pit and decided to roast marshmallows, which was perfect as the grocery store was only 10 minutes away. Beds were also extremely comfortable, felt like a luxurious hotel and the interior design was modern and very well kept. The heated plunge pool was quite big and the perfect temperature as we floated for hours admiring the views during the day and the stars at night. It was truly an unforgettable weekend my family will cherish for years to come!!!

name: Sagar
text: Staying here was such a cool experience. The dome looks amazing and feels very open, but it’s still really warm and cozy inside. I loved being able to look outside and see the trees and the sky right from my bed. It was very quiet and peaceful, making it the perfect place to just relax and take a break from everything. It’s definitely one of the most unique places I’ve ever stayed, and I would go back in a heartbeat.

name: Penny
text: This place is relaxing, and the view is stunning—a great choice for glamping! If you’re planning to visit during the winter, keep in mind that the room can be on the colder side. There was a cleaning issue during our stay as the cleaning team mixed up our check-in date, but Cody handled the situation timely with great communication. In the end, everything worked out, and we had a happy stay with a unique experience!

name: Jess
text: A very unique stay in a peaceful private area! Overall we enjoyed our stay at the Dome. The highlights for us were the master bed, one of the most comfortable airbnb beds we’ve slept in. The heated barrel plunge pool. So relaxing and even better with the string lights off to enjoy all the stars. Unfortunately we felt the dome overall was in need of some love and possibly a good spring cleaning. It’s definitely showing some wear and tear. Lots of stains on the couch, ottoman & even some blood stains on a throw blanket on the couch. Lastly so much clutter everywhere, things for the dome cleaners/owners. Every cabinet drawer in the bathroom filled with dome supplies so you couldn’t unpack toiletries. The biggest issue we had at the dome was someone entered the dome to deliver water while we were out for several hours. That was very unsettling to us since we were not notified. The owner was very quick to respond, apologize and deactivated codes. Just some things to know ahead of booking!
host_response: Response from Eric April 2025 Hey future guests! The dome has been listed for nearly 2 years and it definitely has normal wear and tear, but it is every bit as magical as when we first opened. Jess is a discerning guest for sure and we appreciate her feedback. However, we didn't find any blood stained blanket anywhere. White couches are tough, but we keep it very clean despite the inevitable small stain here and there. The water delivery is not an ongoing problem. We ask the water company to deliver the large jugs inside the door (when guests are not staying there) during the winter so they don't freeze. They made a huge mistake not checking the calendar, so we will be having all water deliveries left outside now and guests will need to assist with bringing them in :) We are doing a series of spring deep cleanings starting today and we look forward to hosting you soon. Message me with any questions or concerns.

name: Luisa
text: I had a wonderful weekend stay overall. The place was clean, comfortable, and well maintained, and everything I needed was provided. The atmosphere was relaxing and made it easy to unwind and enjoy my time there. While the location was a little farther than expected, it didn’t take away from the experience. Everything else was great, and I truly enjoyed my stay. I would definitely recommend it and would be happy to stay again.

name: Quentin
text: For the location and the nice secluded spot this is located in it was such a memorable and charming dome home that my girlfriend and I enjoyed visiting the whole time. We brought food snacks and board games to keep ourselves occupied and bond more with one another and this trip really helped us get closer and share more time together away from the busyness that life brings. I would definitely stay here again and the hot water plunge was amazing as well!

name: Sophie
text: Loved our stay at the dome. Cody is an excellent, responsive and helpful host. If going in the winter (even small amount of snow) you need a four wheel drive car.. the driveway and roads out there are no joke. Besides the car struggles, the Dome itself is beautiful. We hope to return. The plunge pool was bigger than expected and it was pretty magical to be in the hot water while the snow fell around us. Gorgeous views from inside the dome and a lovely and easy to use fireplace inside (you don't need to bring wood for the inside one). Super comfortable beds and overall beautiful.

name: Laurie
text: Our stay at Cody’s Dome was nothing short of magical! The Dome was spacious, clean, and so comfortable (the coziest bed, pillows, and linens). The natural surroundings cannot be beat - meadows of flowers, a walkable path for exploring, majestic mountains, and the perfect place for stargazing. We made use of the hot tub, charcoal grill, and fire pit and savored our moments outdoors! The big couch was the perfect spot to enjoy a morning coffee while taking in the view from inside the Dome. Everything was exactly as described in the listing, and Cody was responsive to our questions every step of the way. We hope to come back to the Dome to experience the wonder of the changing seasons!

name: Paige
text: We loved the dome! We specifically were looking for a place to be able to be in nature and just relax, and this delivered tenfold. The views were gorgeous, the plunge tub was absolutely perfect even when it was snowing! The views in the morning were absolutely top tier. We were very surprised to find that this “glamping” experience was exactly as advertised. The location is incredibly quiet and peaceful and we plan to come back again in the fall.

name: Eden
text: The Dome offers the perfect escape to relax and recharge. Its modern and cozy atmosphere provides a great juxtaposition to the rustic surroundings. While we did explore some of Cody's excellent recommended spots off the property, we also enjoyed spending time hiking the scenic trails and relaxing by the creek on the property itself. Even in the transition to Spring, the beauty of the surroundings was undeniable. The hot tub/dunk pool provided a tranquil setting to either start or end the day, and the extremely comfortable beds ensured a restful night's sleep. Cody's responsiveness and hospitality only added to our wonderful experience. I highly recommend a stay at the Dome and we are already looking forward to returning in the future.

name: Obryant
text: My family and I thoroughly enjoyed our weekend stay at the dome. The dome was exceptionally clean and surprisingly spacious. Cody proactively informed us during our travel that the dome's area had experienced a power outage, which was subsequently resolved. The heated pool was a delightful amenity, and the experience of relaxing in the pool while overlooking the mountains was incredibly serene. I highly recommend this location to anyone seeking a tranquil retreat and an opportunity to disconnect from daily routines for a few days. 5⭐️

name: James
text: Cody’s done in the Catskills is simply sublime. Perfectly appointed, it felt just lux enough to feel in unison with the surroundings. We particularly loved how isolated it felt, yet how accessible it was to the towns and hiking paths in the surrounding area. Highlights were the kitchen, the living space, the lofted bed space and the plunge pool which literally was the perfect place to star gaze. I’d love to recommend but that’ll only create more competition for when we want to go next! Haha but in all honestly do what you can to stay here because it is awesome!

name: Ayanna
text: I had a great trip and stay at the Dome. Check in was easy, the view from the living room was beautiful, and the bed was extremely comfortable. We didn’t use the kitchen, but it had plenty of kitchenware for guests. My boyfriend and I truly enjoyed the property, and Cody’s communication was great. We’re both looking forward to visiting again! Thanks for everything.

name: Courtney
text: We had an amazing stay at the Dome! I go to the Catskills often and this was by far the most unique Airbnb I’ve stayed at. Cool design and super comfortable. We loved the pool and fire pit out back. Very fun to be in the woods and also watch football on Sunday! Our dog was a big fan of the dome life too :) Cody is very responsive and helpful. You can tell he put a lot of time and love into this property. We will definitely be back!

name: Cheryl
text: Such a unique experience! Cody was super responsive, the dome was cozy and well appointed, and the area was spectacular! My husband and I were celebrating our 30th anniversary. We wanted privacy but also the ability to work if need be. The WiFi was strong enough for both of us to video conference at the same time. The plunge pool at night was magical, turn off the lights and marvel at the starry sky! Highly recommend the Catskill Mountain Dome for a peaceful getaway.

name: Ravi
text: Had a wonderful time at the dome. The area was amazing, right next to a beautiful mountain. Cody was very responsive, would respond ASAP to any queries. The hot pool was massive and relaxing. The Wii had a large game selection to choose from. Overall am very excited to come back.

name: David
text: I took my two sons, 12, to the Dome in the Catskills. We loved it so much we immediately took the offer to add another night at the end of our stay. The dome is well apportioned, but you do need to bring firewood and charcoal if you're going to use the firepit and bbq. The Dome not only exceeded our expectations, but the time flew by as we were having such a great stay despite rainy weather. I cannot say enough about Cody's responsiveness and genuine desire to ensure we had a first-class experience. We will be back!

name: Travis
text: Our stay at the dome was lovely. We had no issues what-so-ever and Cody was extremely prompt with all the questions we had before and during our stay. Though the closest towns are small and many shops have limited hours, Stamford and Hobart are only ten minutes away with lots of charm (and so many bookstores). It was such a unique experience and our 5 and 9 year old had a great time running through the paths on the property and hanging out by the fire pit in the outdoor space. On a clear night, the stars are incredible. Highly recommend. Thanks, Cody!

name: Christine
text: The dome and surrounding property was so beautiful and comfortable. The place looked even better than the photos. To make it even better, Cody was an amazing host. He was so responsive and helpful. His recommendations for food and activities were top notch. Highly recommend staying here for a nice getaway!

name: Sara
text: We stayed her for our wedding anniversary and it was absolutely gorgeous and beyond special. The place is clean, Cody is responsive and attentive to our needs. We were beyond cozy and happy to have our time together.

name: Katriona
text: Couldn’t be happier. Came up here for a couple of nights away from the city to catch the Lyrid meteor shower and this place was absolutely perfect. Clean, stylish, comfortable, and the (absolutely massive and always warm) hot tub was the big draw for us. Also, the listing is not kidding, super modern bathroom with excellent water pressure and tons of hot water. Highly recommend and we will be coming back.

name: Adam
text: We were in town for a wedding and stumbled upon this place and took a shot in the dark and my were we impressed. We absolutely fell in love with the location. The inside of the dome was cozy and attractive, and when we needed something they had it in the Yurt. Cody was responsive, kind, and helpful. Frankly, we were sad to leave. The view of the autumn trees was gorgeous, and the starry sky at night was to die for. We left and all acknowledged that we'd love to come back. 10/10, great experience!

name: Gabriela
text: Wow, just got back from Cody's dome, and I gotta say, it was incredible! The dome looked amazing in the photos, but seeing it in real life, especially with the snow falling, was something else. It's like our own little winter fairytale igloo. We were a bit worried it might be chilly inside because of the whole dome thing, but it was super warm and cozy – perfect for chilling by the fireplace. The place was spotless, and the decor was so cute and stylish – great for snapping some pics. Plus, the kitchen had everything we needed. Cody was an awesome host! He was always just a text away, super helpful. Like when our light's battery died, he actually called around stores for us to find a replacement. And his tips on where to go around town (especially restaurants!) were spot on – we had such a blast. Also big shoutout for getting someone to clear the snow from the driveway in the morning after the blizzard. That was a lifesaver! We will be definitely returning soon!!

name: Jamie
text: Our weather could have been better (mud!) but it was great nonetheless. Beds were very comfortable and host was quick to respond when we had questions. My kids (7 and 9) loved the pool/hot tub and loft. Keep in mind the limited options for dining early in the week. Thanks for a nice family getaway!

name: Deborah
text: The dome was really unique and my kids loved it. It was also very clean and had luxurious beds, pillows, and linens. While there, we enjoyed kayaking and swimming at Susan’s Pleasant Pheasant Farm. We also had dinner at 80 Main in Delphi, which was very good. My advice to any parents that are considering this rental…only rent if your kids will listen to you. The reason for this is the loft bedroom. It’s a really cool space but the ladder rungs are widely spaced and slippery, the transition to the top is difficult, it’s possible to fall over the wall, and the drop to the concrete floor is really far…I’m guessing more than 10 feet. This should not be treated like a bunk bed. Note that the plunge pool is wood and the tannins make the water brown and it’s filled with small pieces of detritus. But it obviously has filtration. We enjoyed using it in the evening! Don’t forget kindling, wood, sticks and marshmallows for some nice time at the fire pit!

name: Ca
text: Stayed for a couple of nights. Everything was fabulous and we enjoyed our stay! The plunge pool was super relaxing and smokeless fire pit was very cool. We enjoyed watching the stars…never saw so many in our lives; even saw the Milky Way! Stunning mountains surrounding you and plenty of things to so and yummy places to eat. Thx so much; will definitely return! The pups also had a great time and were exhausted from all the fresh air and activities.

name: Olivia
text: We had such a great stay at the dome! We were honestly so upset we only stayed two nights and would absolutely plan to come back again. We had a few plans to explore locally, but ended up just staying in and enjoying the dome instead cooking a few simple meals, taking in the view, and spending quality family time. The place was fully stocked with tons of blankets, pillows, towels, cooking utensils, condiments and really everything you could need. We were super impressed! Cody was also incredibly easy to communicate with, which made the whole experience even better.

name: Ryan
text: What a unique experience and beautiful scenery. Everything was as described and matched pictures to a T. We had a great time enjoying the space and nature. Can’t wait to show off the pictures. Great host and excellent stay.

name: Allison
text: The dome was such a beautiful spot for a getaway! My boyfriend and I went for the weekend with our dog, who had the time of his life running around in the snow. The inside of the dome was so beautiful and just as pictured in the photos. The kitchen was well stocked with most everything you’d need to cook meals along with a traditional drip coffee maker for morning coffee. Overall it was such a lovely place. We did run into a few issues during our stay, including a heater in the bedroom not working, which ultimately led to our 4 star rating. But Cody was responsive when issues arose (such as walking us through what to do when the water wasn’t running upon arrival) and was a great host. And you cant beat the views! Would definitely recommend. P.S. if you are going in the winter, be forewarned that you may need to shovel if you want to have a bonfire. I ended up shoveling for about 40 minutes because I was very determined to make a path to the fire pit!

name: Katelyn
text: Beautiful dome and stunning surroundings. This place would be optimal in the summer months. The dome was comfortable and spacious, but a little cold despite the heat being on. The hot tub was great and surrounds such stunning views- as it was primarily raining during our stay, we did not get to enjoy the outside space as much.

name: Rachel
text: The Dome was an amazing property to stay at. Amazing views and surrounded by nature. Very private but close enough to markets, restaurants and a ton of used book stores. Inside the dome was as pictured. Very clean and well appointed. The kitchen area met all of our needs and we cooked for almost every meal. The smart oven and the outdoor grill both cooked up some amazing meals. The kitchen might be cramped for some, but worked for us. The lofted bed has a sky light that you can see the stars from at night! We had no issues with indoor temp or water pressure. The living room was super relaxing and spacious. Cody was very responsive to all questions and issues we had. The outside area did seem to need a little attention. The outdoor picnic table was broken, which Cody said just happened and would be fixed soon. All in all a great experience!

name: Tracy
text: We loved our Dome house stay! Despite a rainy fall weekend, we loved the hot tub, walked down to the stream on the trails, and watched a movie while cozy in the dome. Would absolutely stay here again!

name: Brianna
text: We booked the dome for our mini-moon and it was honestly the best decision we made. I regret not booking it for longer!! I also regret not using the fire pit, haha. The dome is exactly as pictured, and Cody put a lot of effort into ensuring the dome is well equipped. Other than food, you are literally all set. Bring your own games if you're looking for additional entertainment. There was a Wii, a few card games, and a massive bookshelf. I loved that the kitchen was fully functioning with the table top as additional counter space! The bathroom was modern and each room with a door had its own heating system. Cody was extremely quick to respond and fulfilled any request that we had. We went out once, and the locals are genuinely nice. Two BIG FYIs... if you don't have SUV, rent one if you intend on adventuring out. It really is kind of backroad'ish which adds to the appeal. Screenshot all door access/wifi codes well ahead of your arrival and read thoroughly. We intend on returning!!!

name: Fangzhou
text: We were expecting spring weather for some activities around the area but ended up with a big snow day. The dome offered enough that we didn’t feel stuck even though we spent most of our time on the property. The photos are attractive already but we are still wowed when seeing it real life. It was a great and unique experience. It feels like one can always find some way to enjoy the stay regardless of the weather!

name: Karenine
text: The dome was beautifully decorated and very comfortable. The view was so beautiful and peaceful! We had everything we needed. The heated pool was amazing! Two small complaints: The outside furniture looks very run down. And we could have benefited from having one extra set of towels for pool and shower. The hosts were very responsive and sent amazing recommendations for the area.

name: Michele
text: Both Cody and Nicole were a pleasure to communicate with. The Dome was just as expected, beautiful, peaceful, and extremely relaxing. We loved that they allowed our pets and our children and although it was during the muddy season they assured us to not worry too much and just relax. Amazing hospitality!

name: Stacy
text: Our stay at the Catskills dome was amazing. The location and views from the property were so picturesque. Cody was very responsive and helpful with any questions we had during our stay. The dome was beautifully decorated and had all the amenities we needed. We are already planning another trip back!

name: Rebeca
text: Such a beautiful place! Amazing view, within Cody’s place there’s so much to do to just relax and unwind. The recommended activities and restaurants did not disappoint. Cody was in top of everything and quick to respond. Such a great experience, we will absolutely be back!

name: Alexis
text: Cody is an amazing host! Incredibly kind and responsive. The Catskill Mountain Dome was magical and truly a space to enjoy year round! The dome was so unique - It’s filled with natural light and the interior decor was so beautiful. The heated plunge pool was awesome, and you’re surrounded by mountains and fields of wildflowers. An unforgettable experience. I am so excited to return!

name: Hailey
text: This place is amazing. Beautiful views, cozy interior, and a couple miles from town. We were so excited to get into the Dome, and we were not disappointed once we opened the door. It was clean and cozy, we couldn’t wait to start relaxing. Cody was incredibly responsive to any and all questions, and clear on any instructions needed. All in all, we are very pleased we chose the Dome for our vacation.

name: Esrale
text: Truly a memorable, heart-warming Dome experience. It was a Christmas vacation with my family and if only you could see our photos, the smiles would be more than enough proof that we all did have a great time. Cody is indeed a great host-- very responsive and accommodating. He was really helpful and assisted us with all our questions. The Dome is exceptionally clean and has every kitchen utensils you would need for a 2-nights stay (we only had to bring a rice cooker). Strongly recommend & will surely go back!

name: Alison
text: Cody’s place was so unique! Everything was well appointed in the dome space while still feeling luxurious. The tv and entertainment options helped with the rainy days. The kitchen had plenty of cooking supplies and it was lovely to sit on the comfortable couch with a cup of tea and look out of the dome walls at the countryside. Cody was very proactive with communication and also very responsive. Overall a super fun experience in the beautiful Catskills.

name: Frida
text: Our host was very responsive! Helped us with everything we needed to know before our trip. Responded rapidly to our questions throughout our trip. I would highly recommend staying at this Airbnb. Very clean, very cozy, super relaxing!

name: Elijah
text: The dome was gorgeous and the surrounding was beautiful. It was a very comfortable stay we will definitely be coming back again. Everything was as described and more.

name: Amanda
text: My family and I had a wonderful, relaxing stay. The accommodations are very welcoming and cozy. The hot tub is a huge bonus. My kids enjoyed catching fish in the pond on site. Breathtaking views and sounds of nature. This dome has everything you need and more. The host was very friendly and helpful. We look forward to our next trip.

name: Keon
text: Excellent. Quality top notch experience. Host was super responsive and attentive to all needs. Beautiful location. Pictures do not do justice. Great trails. Lounge area with plunge pool was bigger than expected. Amenities listed were more than efficient. Great decor with attention to detail. Not one complaint. Could not recommend more.

name: Indira
text: The dome was exactly as advertised - a beautiful getaway with all of the comforts of home. The space was welcoming and very clean. The beds were comfortable and the views were amazing. Cody was responsive and provided all of the necessary information for the stay.

name: Vivian Elizabeth
text: Beautiful location, perfect place to get away from everything. The kitchen was clean and well stocked which made cooking easy. The big cedar hot tub was SO nice. Because the location is remote, we could see lots of stars, the Milky Way and even a few shooting stars. It rained part of our stay, but there are lots of books and games in the Dome, to play until the sky’s cleared. We are already talking about when we can come back.

name: Ya Ying
text: Nice dome and very friendly host. The dome has everything you need inside, and the outdoor environment is wonderful for BBQ, relaxing in the pool, and enjoying nature. We really enjoyed our stay here!

name: Nithin
text: Cody’s geodome was beautiful! We had a great weekend here and would suggest it to anyone else looking for a peaceful getaway with friends or family. The dome looks small from the outside but has plenty of space for guests. We never felt cramped. The kitchen has most of the essentials you’d need for a getaway. The highlight of the trip was the hot tub area with the mountains in the backdrop. The hot tub itself was amazing. Even with the rain, we still enjoyed being in there. We utilized the grill and the fire pit as well. Overall, a great stay, and we would love to go back again!

name: Jo
text: We had such a great stay at the dome! It’s a great peaceful location, really unique and memorable accommodation and Cody is a great, communicative host. We stayed on a wintery weekend with snow, but the dome was nice and cosy inside - It is glamping so you do need to wrap up but we loved the whole experience. The dome is just as described, nicely furnished and with everything you need including a good selection of board games. We loved exploring the area and hikes nearby. We were glad we had our 4WD! Highly recommend!

name: Karen
text: The yard is a very cool place to stay! It is decorated quite tastefully, and so unique. We loved the multiple bedrooms and the way it was set up. There are TVs everywhere. It was nice for us because we were happy to be off the road for a few days and quite relaxing. I would recommend taking plenty to do and cook out and things like that. We tried to find some restaurants and most were not open. A pool, Which is really a hot tub is very nice but it is down the hill. Beautiful surroundings and nice natural flowers.

name: Sarah
text: If you love nature and want to enjoy a personal relationship with every star in the sky, stay here. What a stunning location and home. The host is also very responsive and accommodating. Fully plan to stay here again!

name: Ulziimaa
text: The place looks exactly like the photos. It's very private, secluded and peaceful. As per Cody's guide book, a lot of places were closed in the area but we were already made aware. It just gave us more time at the place and we cooked and grilled. The place was clean and thoughtfully decorated. The outdoor area was great with choices of seating. Somehow we didn't have a lot of bugs in the area. We did have some hickups with the pool, lock and shower. But Cody was very responsive and went above and beyond to ensure we had the best experience possible. We will be back the 1st chance we get.

name: Joseph
text: The dome was beautiful and just what we were looking for. Cody was proactive, reaching out to us with information before we needed it, but did not hound us either. Great stay, will likely come again.

name: Warkiria
text: My husband and I had an amazing experience with this getaway. It was private, peaceful and the home was very unique and relaxing. My favorite amenity was the outdoor hot tub felt so relaxing. Overall it was a getaway that we definitely needed. Definitely going back!

name: Emma
text: Such a fantastic spot! After our wedding weekend, my husband & I stayed at Cody’s place for a few days off the grid, relaxing & decompressing. It was everything we needed & more! Cody was quickly responsive & wonderfully helpful; the guidebook to the area he sent along was enormously helpful! The views were breathtaking, the place was quiet & serene… we hope to visit again! Couldn’t recommend enough!

name: Corinne
text: My fiancé and I needed a place to get away for a few days to celebrate our engagement…this little dome in the middle of nowhere was perfect. Unfortunately for us, we experienced some of the worst wind EVER our first night there. It knocked out the power for the first evening/night so there were several scrabble games played by lantern. We let Cody know about it in the morning and he was super responsive and sympathetic. His partner later recommended a hidden local speakeasy which was adorable with the sweetest bartenders. So, even though there were a couple setbacks, this was still one of my favorite stays I’ve ever had. Big recommend for a little romantic getaway!

name: Jiawen
text: We spent 5 nights here. It’s a really nice place, beautifully sitting in the mountain, peaceful and relaxing. Great neighborhood as well, groceries, horse riding, hiking are really convenient! Cody is a great host, he responded quickly, were very friendly.

name: Sharima
text: Cody was an excellent host all Of his instructions were clear and thorough. He responded to all my questions and concerns immediately! The dome looked exactly like the pictures on the site. The dome was very cozy clean and comfortable. My family had such an amazing time here!

name: Matthew
text: What a gorgeous, unique experience! We loved cozying up inside the dome, looking out over the snow-covered hills outside. Cody was extremely prepared, attentive, and responsive when we had questions about the home or the surrounding area. The nearby Hobart Book Village was delightful, and Cody's restaurant recommendations were spectacular.

name: Michael
text: To say this place is special is an understatement. From the moment you arrive, to the moment you leave, it makes you feel like you’re away from everything. That’s the exact reason why we came and it did the job perfectly. Everything was provided with excellent quality, from Cody’s interior design choices, to checking in, and anything else that may come up. If you’re looking for a place to recharge and get back to nature, this is for you. If it hasn’t been booked, make sure you grab this one, you won’t regret it.

name: Liam
text: This was a very wonderful stay. The dome is truly magical and was exactly what what we had hoped for. It got really cold outside while we were there, but the dome stayed nice and warm and cozy the whole time. Cody and Nicole are greats hosts. Cody helped us with any questions we had during our stay, and responded very quickly to messages. We will definitely be back!

name: Tammy
text: Mother daughter weekend was wonderful! Host was incredibly responsive and helpful. We found the place easily and enjoyed every moment of our stay! Check out Hobart Book Village while you’re in the area. Would love to see it in the winter too!

name: Jesi
text: my boyfriend and I LOVED our stay at the dome. it was so clean, private, and cozy. the drive to get there was beautiful & the views at the dome even more beautiful! the heated plunge pool was incredible, the beds were incredibly comfortable, and even just cuddling up on the couch to watch a movie with the view of the mountains behind us was amazing. everything in the dome is so thoughtfully put together from the overall design to the games available to play to the seasonings in the kitchen to use. cannot recommend this place enough. it was a bit of a splurge for us, but so incredibly special that it was totally worth it. hosts were quick to respond and very helpful! would love to stay here again!

name: Jasmine
text: Had a very cozy stay with my family on one of the coldest weekends. It was a winter wonderland! The property and surrounding area is so beautiful and peaceful, especially when covered in snow. The dome was like a real life igloo except with lots of heat to keep you warm. We had TVs in every room, the mattresses and couches were comfortable. We felt right at home. The hosts were there for us when and if we needed. We could not be happier with our experience and hope to be back during the warmer months. Thank you for everything! :)

name: Kaitlyn
text: We got the opportunity to spend the weekend at the dome, and it was an incredible experience. Our host, Cody, was super responsive and provided us with everything we needed, from check-in to check-out. The property is breathtaking, and the dome is an exact replica of all the pictures provided. Cody also provided us with a list of the many things you can do around the area, from dining to the best slopes for snow tubing. I chose this location for a proposal, and it did not disappoint. I highly recommend choosing this dome for your next stay; the magic it brings is better than Disney.

name: Jayden
text: Such a gorgeous, comfy, convenient place to stay. We had such a wonderful time - easy to find, super clean, close to everything, and Cody was super responsive and available! Would definitely come back again :)

name: John
text: Cody was an amazing host. The dome felt like a palace. Beautiful inside and out. Super comfortable furniture and bedding. Smart TVs in 2 of the 3 bedrooms and living room. The yard was very nice. Plunge pool/sauna. There is plenty of outdoor seating. Games inside and out. Easy to find and easy to park. 4 wheel drive definitely helps. I highly recommend staying here.

name: Pol
text: Incredible space, everything was excellent. We did have a little issue with the heat but Cody was super helpful. Looking forward to coming back to this beautiful space again!

name: Linda
text: The dome is a unique experience! The view is incredible in both the plunge pool and the living area of the dome. It felt like being at home, but with a much better view. The dome is fully furnished and you really didn't want or need anymore. Thank you for a great stay!

name: Anaïs
text: Staying at the Dome had been on my bucket list for a while, so I was thrilled to find it available after 4th of July. Upon arrival, we were captivated by the Dome itself and the stunning views. The summer landscape, with its beautiful flowers and clear sky, was simply gorgeous. The natural light, décor, and thoughtful layout made the space feel perfect. We were pleasantly surprised by how spacious it was inside, and the beds were incredibly comfortable with a TV in each room. The living area, which opened up to the beautiful mountains, quickly became our favorite hangout spot, both day and night. Even better, the Dome is dog-friendly, which is crucial for me when traveling. My pup loved the walking trails around the property, and we felt completely at ease having him with us. We ended up spending most of our time at the Dome, only venturing out for coffee at Stamford Coffee, which was fantastic. Thank you Cody for being a wonderful host! We would love to come back during the winter.

name: Jason
text: We had such a wonderful few days and nights at the dome super comfortable with all the best finishes inside. Awesome outdoor area and hot tub that overlooks the beautiful mountains. Great little towns in all directions to explore and Cody was definitely a 5 star host. Thank you!

name: Kyle
text: This dome getaway has everything you need. I wanted to get off the grid for my birthday and this place is perfect for that. Beautiful mountain scenery, excellent backyard/chill area and warm cozy bed/couch/dome stay. Has just enough space for 6. I would’ve liked a bigger grill but we still managed. The hot tub was a perfect 101 degrees. It is extremely dark in this area and would recommend a flashlight for any future stays.

name: Adena
text: The dome was a lovely place to spend our “minimoon.” We hit a few snags when we first arrived (the heat was temporarily broken). Cody was incredibly responsive and had it fixed asap, and definitely went the extra mile to make it up to us. Beautiful spot and great amenities.

name: 金石
text: It’s a very secluded getaway in Upstate New York! The surrounding view is amazing, and the design of the property is very elegant, beautiful but without flamboyant features. Cody is very helpful and responsive. A 4WD/AWD is indeed needed to get very close to the dome when there is heavy snow on the ground. Other than that, definitely an ideal place to chill & relax with couple of friends & families.

name: Greg
text: Catskills Mountains Dome is a serene place to enjoy either a romantic getaway, family "glamping" experience, or peaceful retreat. The views of the mountains and valleys take you away from the clutter of your busy life and just allow you to truly relax and unwind. The dome provides all of the comforts of home - allowing for a camping experience without all the extra work. Cody is an excellent and communicative host, providing excellent instructions and recommendations to make your stay a breeze. The Dome itself is comfortable and modern. Beds are fantastic, wi-fi service is spot on (which is helpful as there is basically no cell phone service). The hot tub/plunge pool is a great added bonus and temperature is easily adjusted by communicating with Cody. Kitchen has all basic necessities for simple cooking, which is useful as you are truly out in the woods and access to restaurants is somewhat limited. If you are a light sleeper - just bring ear plugs and a sleep mask.

name: Jackson
text: The dome exceeded our expectations! Great vibes, great atmosphere and the hot tub was so good it was utilized every single day (rain or shine). Cody was so helpful and always responsive to answer any of our random questions throughout our stay. Already planning our next trip back! - thanks for a great getaway :)

name: Joseph
text: Great stay. Cozy place. The dome home is a unique and beautiful place to stay that's a great escape from the city. The cherry on top of our stay is that the host was very responsive and communicative. Any difficulties we had during our stay was quickly and conveniently resolved thanks to the host's responsiveness. Definitely recommend this place.

name: Kristopher
text: My family and I highly recommend this place. It’s beautiful and amazing. It’s also Kid Friendly. Dome was equipped with everything. Heating inside the Dome was just perfect. We are already planning a 2nd trip to stay at the Dome. Thank You Cody and Nicole for a Wonderful Experience.

name: Tracy
text: My partner and I spent a fantastic week in the dome. It’s a beautiful and cozy, mindfully built home. Cody was always very responsive and made sure all maintenance during a snow storm was taken care of in a timely manner. We loved the cedar hot tub which was always kept warm and ready. We’d love to come back again!

name: Caitlin
text: My husband and I booked this beautiful space for our stay for our wedding at a nearby venue. This was the most perfect and peaceful , unique place for us! Absolutely worth the stay if you want to relax and disconnect!

name: Jorge
text: My wife and I spent a magical weekend at the Geo Dome with friends. Nestled in nature with snow-capped mountains, the setting was perfect. The dome was cozy and modern, offering stunning views. A highlight was the hot tub, where we soaked in warm water amidst the crisp mountain air. Inside, the bedrooms were comfortable, and the living room maximized the views. Our host was attentive, ensuring a perfect stay. We’d love to return in the warmer season. The Geo Dome is a gem for nature lovers seeking comfort.

name: Rachel
text: We had a wonderful stay at the dome. The space felt cozy and unique, and the views were absolutely stunning. The property is incredibly peaceful and made for a perfect winter getaway. Highly recommended!

name: Sherry
text: The dome was stylish and spacious. As a hot sleeper, I initially panicked when the A/C in the king bedroom wouldn’t turn on. But Cody responded to my concern immediately and reassured me that the living room units would keep things cool. He was absolutely right—they worked perfectly! After a deep and restful sleep, I woke early and was captivated by the starlit sky visible from the living room before sunrise. The view was so stunning, I couldn’t help but wake my fiancé so we could take it in together. One of the most unforgettable moments was watching the harvest supermoon rise above the mountains while we sat around the firepit, sipping tea. It was breathtaking. We spent time biking and soaking in the outdoors, and the dome itself was a cozy retreat. On our final night, we took advantage of the kitchen amenaties, cooked a delicious dinner, and watched scary movies while listening to the rain. If you're looking to escape the chaos of the world, Cody's place is the perfect getaway!

name: Paul Andres
text: It was the best getaway i’ve had with my wife ,It’s very peaceful with the best views of the mountains,the host was also very responsive and friendly gave us some good spot recommendations!!

name: Andrea
text: The dome was very spacious and clean. The view was gorgeous! This was the perfect glamping location. The pool was nice to walk around and read in.

name: Jason
text: The done was so luxurious yet off very private and peaceful. Cody was very flexible and helpful remotely as he helped us with the temperature. Wonderful wonderful place.

name: Jing
text: One of the most unique and beautiful place to stay! Waking up to a serene view really helped me stop ruminating about work. Cody has always been so welcoming and responsive to our requests and questions, which made the entire stay seamless and easy! Highly recommended for a long term stay or a weekend getaway!

name: Dana
text: We greatly enjoyed our time at the dome! We loved the peaceful area and that it was a quick drive to all of the surrounding towns and restaurants. The space was clean and modern and we loved the hot tub and fire pit out back!

name: Kaimook
text: Amazing place! We had a lovely time. Clean, amazing view, great plunge pool and host is super responsive. Some insects during the summer so bring insect repellent!

name: Toral
text: Cody’s place was beautiful. One of the best airbnb we stayed at. Serene views and perfect cozy nights with fire pit outdoor and hot tub for our girls retreat. Host did great job with the whole dome decor and using space so well. It was spacious for 5 of us. 100 % recommend Cody’s gorgeous space.

name: Michelle
text: So beautiful and relaxing and such a responsive host. The beds were so comfy. The pool was amazing as were the views.

name: Nayely
text: Our days here were delightful we completely love the dome everything was very clean, the area was really peaceful it was a nice break from the city. Cody was an excellent host always very friendly and respond every single question his attentions made our stay much better.

name: Sunny
text: Beautiful isolated place but not far from town. Loved the hot tub and view from the dome. Hope to be back again someday!

name: Joel
text: If you're looking for a relaxing getaway to "disconnected" from this overly connected world, then Cody's dome is a great place. My wife, two dogs and I really enjoyed our stay. A beautiful interior coupled with walking trails for our dogs, a wonderful pool that was perfectly heated. We originally had local dinner reservations but decided it would be better just to eat at the Dome and enjoy dusk in the Catskills with a wonderful view.

name: Lindsay
text: Beautiful stay tucked away in the Catskills! Unique experience, relaxing, peaceful and quiet. Beautiful and clean! Definitely would stay again!

name: Pamela
text: We had an amazing time at the dome for our girls weekend. It was cold and windy with some rain but it didn’t matter- the dome was beautiful and very comfortable. Would definitely stay again!

name: Mike
text: Great place to stay. Cody was very responsive. My only suggestion would be to have lights that are always on by the entrance parking area. It’s pitch black at night time unless you trigger the sensor. Otherwise, 5 stars

name: Adrienne
text: Dome, sweet dome! What a unique experience! We had a wonderful visit in a tranquil and relaxing space. Everything was clean and check-in was easy and streamlined. Cody is an excellent host! Super responsive and he ensured our stay was as comfortable as possible. A wonderful winter weekend away.

name: Jordan
text: Great unique stay- so clean and spacious with cute towns to visit all around. Hot tub was amazing and Cody was super helpful with everything.

name: Sam
text: This place is absolutely amazing! It has this incredible NYC vibe, but it's nestled right in the midst of nature. It's just so peaceful and serene, we can't get enough of it! And let me tell you, the hot tub and fireplace are to die for. We're already counting down the days until we can come back again! Oh, and I have to give a shoutout to Cody - he's an absolute gem. Always there when we needed him, a true gentleman. It's clear he's a superhost through and through!

name: Sarah
text: Our family LOVED visiting the beautiful dome home. The location is beautiful, peaceful, and we loved the scenic views. The dome was clean and fully stocked with toiletries. Cody was a fabulous host and great at communicating. Highly recommend visiting this gem!

name: Tenzin
text: Beautiful stay!!!! My boyfriend & I had the most wonderful time at Cody’s place. I cannot wait to come back during the colder weather. Very private and relaxing. Highly recommend!

name: Gary
text: Great stay to get away from the city. Beautiful scenery and amenities.

name: Madeline
text: This spot was perfect for a weekend getaway! We did have some difficulty with the heating and lighting. Cody was responsive and tried to help. There was quite a bit of snow which made it hard to access the outdoor space.

name: Jeanette
text: Beautiful setting, peaceful, and unlike any other place we’ve ever stayed! Cody was super helpful and quick to respond to every question. Wish we had a few more days to relax and enjoy this place!

name: Kyetah
text: Cody was a great super-host who was very friendly and responsive. The place is beautifully architecture and the interior brings warmth and coziness. I enjoyed the home and hope to have another stay in the near future. The surrounding landscape of the mountains, greenery and sky just made for a real home-away-from experience.

name: Sarah
text: We loved our stay at the dome! Cody was an amazing host, always responsive, kind and accommodating. The dome itself is a very cool and unique experience. The interior is so well-done and they’ve spared no detail…the kitchen has a filtered water dispenser, ice maker, toaster oven/air fryer, all the cookware, utensils, quality glassware and dishes. Bedrooms are outfitted with multi-chargers so anyone can charge their devices. The bathroom is super well-designed and also has everything you could ever need. The bed features hotel-quality linens and was extremely comfortable. Outside, the amenities keep going with a lovely heated plunge pool that was super fun to hang in during the day. I can’t tell you how lovely it was to float around surrounded by the gorgeous mountain views. There were also cornhole boards, a great variety of outdoor seating and an awesome fire pit. We enjoyed it all! To top it all off, this area of the Catskills is truly gorgeous, full of epic vistas.

name: Sara
text: We had an amazing time at the Catskills dome! It’s such a unique and secluded space in a great location. Soaking in the heated plunge pool with a view of the mountains was so serene and magical. Cody was an impeccable host, offering plenty of assistance and recommendations before and during our stay.

name: Varad
text: Cody was an amazing host, very responsive and helpful! The dome itself was amazing! The location was private and peaceful, and the dome itself had everything you would need. The outdoor area is truly beautiful, turn the lights off and admire the moon & stars. Will definitely be back!

name: Ruth
text: This is the first time I ever stayed in a dome and it was the BEST experience, no doubt in my mind! There’s no light pollution because of the area and we are so high up the mountain that the day time the sun fills the place with natural light & in the night the sky filled of stars are dreamy. I am the type to stay at these houses and cook full meals, and I can say it is possible. The beds are all comfy, there are lots of blankets for a comfy feel. It’s just brick in the night but nothing that a good paid of PJs and blankets won’t fix. I loved everything about it, 100% recommend and would die to come back any time I can. Host was highly respectable, prompt with answers and polite.

name: Emily
text: If you’re looking for the perfect getaway to the mountains, I definitely recommend staying at this unique dome house! The indoor space is beautiful and decorated well. The dome is surrounded by flowers, trails and stunning Mountain View’s. I enjoyed my time hanging out in the heated pool and by the fire pit. I had such a lovely stay and Cody is such a great host.

name: Regan
text: Very responsive host, great communication and made sure we have everything we needed for the stay!

name: Karen
text: What an experience!! We loved reconnecting with Nature. Everything was as described. Truly a glamping experience, we went in the winter and it was a bit chilly for me but understandably haha! Kitchen is well equipped, the bathroom is clean, the bedrooms are very comfortable. Cody is very responsive and informative! I recommend it!

name: Kellyann
text: We had an AMAZING stay! My husband and I came here after our wedding in the Catskills and it was the perfect getaway! The dome is so unique, well kept, and cozy. Thank you so much!

name: Tara
text: This has been one of the best Airbnb's I've ever stayed in...a magical place. A stunning location and absolutely perfect inside the dome. Cody has thought of everything and is also extremely helpful and responsive. Will definitely be coming back!

name: Jhennifer
text: We had a wonderful stay. Communication with the host was excellent, the place was very quiet, and it was the perfect spot to relax and unwind. Highly recommend!

name: Vincent
text: The dome was an amazing experience and Cody was a great host. Everything we needed was right there at our fingertips, and Cody was very responsive when we had questions. We can't wait to go back in the summer!

name: Steven
